CustomField.description: Defines whether Contact__c holds an accounting role within the supplier's organization, and defines certain permissions granted to him/ her for the related Negoscope__c. By default in Connect, a contact who has Primary or Secondary accounting role in COD will be able to gain access to records related to the Negoscope in the following objects : Invoice__c, Payment, SellInStatement__c, Negoscope__c, SupplierPgMapping__c, Negoptim_File__c (RT = Invoice, Credit Note, ...TBC)
CustomField.label: Accounting Role
